body: apps/server now captures the real IDUNA player_id from connect tickets instead of discarding it (client_player_id/client_has_player_id per slot) -- the prerequisite Phase B replay logging needs. Ported http_client.h + IDUNA agent config from shankpit-460. Deliberately did not wire match-result reporting -- IDUNA's /session endpoint is FPS-shaped (kills/deaths), REDGARDEN's match_winner isn't; flagged as an open schema question. test_10_bots.sh + test_arena.sh green. Commit cea0704. BACKLOG S170-26.
